part: Section/panel card — the list surfaces' rail card (ruling 5.1)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.4 (rail labels convention); 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' the Legend rail card shared by artboards 02/04/06/08/11; operator ruling 5.1 ('the graduated rule ABOVE the section title wins... Applies to every panel/section card on every page')
notes: ListSurfaceRailCards.tsx (RailCard, used by LegendRailCard and every other rail card the five list surfaces render) is pure inline style; every property here is a real product value.

This is the ONE panel/section card shape shared by all five list surfaces (Regulations/Market/Research/Operations/Watchlist) that carries a visible title — the OTHER card on those pages (ListSurfaceShell's per-band grouping, `BandSectionHeader`) uses its own distinct convention (a coloured 3px TOP-BORDER per band, `borderTop:'3px solid '+band.cssVar`, README §0.2's band scale, not ruling 5.1's dark-grey gradation) and is NOT this ruling's target — a band subsection is not a titled panel in the ruling's sense, it is the list's own per-band grouping, unchanged by this ruling.

FIXED (fix58-lists, 2026-09-07, B170): RailCard.tsx now mounts `<SectionRule/>` (src/components/ui/SectionRule.tsx) as the first child inside the card's outer border/radius/shadow div, matching `DashboardBrief.tsx`'s own `Card` convention (page-frame.json) exactly — the rule sits full-width at the true top edge, so the outer div itself can carry no padding any more; content padding (14px 16px, unchanged) moved to a new inner wrapper div, checked separately below.

The title itself ('Legend') is styled 10.5px/800/.12em uppercase — README §0.4's RAIL LABEL convention, not the Anton section-title convention ruling 5.1 also states ('Section title itself: Anton uppercase, no divider, no underline'). Whether a rail card's meta-style label counts as ruling 5.1's 'section title' (requiring Anton) is not resolved by the ruling's own wording — it names the DASHBOARD's own primary section titles ('Due Next', 'By Urgency') as its worked example, and a rail card's compact label is a documented, PRE-EXISTING distinct convention (README type scale: 'rail labels 10.5px uppercase .12em/700'), so this is logged as an open question for a future lane rather than asserted as a MISMATCH against a scale the ruling did not clearly extend to this element.

children.name: ruling 5.1 rule ABOVE the title
children.note: Ruling 5.1: 3px, full width, top edge, no radius, `linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))`. FIXED (B170): RailCard.tsx now mounts this as its first child.

children.name: content wrapper — padding (moved off the outer card div so the rule can sit at the true top edge)
children.note: Same 14px 16px content padding as before B170, now on the inner wrapper below SectionRule (SectionRule is itself a <div>, the wrapper's first child — `:last-child` reaches the content wrapper, not the rule).

children.name: title (rail-label convention, not asserted as a MISMATCH against Anton per the note above)
